templates.title: Fitness Certificate - Medical Center Incharge (Bannari Amman Institute of Technology)
templates.description: Official 24-point infrastructure & medical fitness certificate audit checklist categorized into 6 core operational headers: Cleaning, Electrical, Network, Plumbing, Documentation, and Feedback.
templates.createdBy: Professor In-charge (Bannari Amman Institute of Technology)

questions.questionText: Did you check the waste disposal & cleaning work?
questions.description: Verify general waste disposal, daily housekeeping routine, and cleanliness.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which waste disposal area failed sanitation standards?
Was improper segregation of hazardous medical waste observed?

questions.questionText: Did you check the General Amenities?
questions.description: Check patient seating, drinking water dispenser, and waiting hall amenities cleanliness.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Specify which general amenity requires repair or replacement.

questions.questionText: Whether the workplace infrastructure maintained properly?
questions.description: Inspect wall paint, doors, window glazing, ceiling, and structural flooring integrity.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Is there visible structural damage, dampness, or broken fixtures?

questions.questionText: Are all emergency doors open freely without obstacles?
questions.description: Verify panic bar latches and clear un-obstructed passage in emergency exit corridors.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: What obstacle is blocking the emergency exit doorway?

questions.questionText: Did you check the disposal of Medicine and Medical waste?
questions.description: Verify bio-medical waste disposal, bio-hazard bin color liners, and sharp needle box.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Is expired medicine disposed of per biomedical waste protocol?

questions.questionText: Did you check Bed Making?
questions.description: Check clean linen, pillow covers, bed sheet sterilization, and mattress hygiene.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: How many patient observation beds are missing clean sterile linen?

questions.questionText: Are all the floors & restrooms cleaned properly?
questions.description: Check floor cleaning log, disinfectant mopping, and restroom sanitation.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which restroom or bay failed hygiene standards?

questions.questionText: Are the scrap removed periodically?
questions.description: Verify scrap clearance from rear yard, storage rooms, and corridors.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Where is un-cleared scrap accumulated in the facility?

questions.section: 2. Electrical (Equipment, Devices, CCTV, UPS, Lighting & Fire Safety)
questions.questionText: Are all the Safety equipment working in good condition?
questions.description: Inspect main electrical safety gear, eyewash, emergency showers, and protective devices.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which specific safety equipment item is damaged or out of service?
Is replacement safety equipment available in the central store?

questions.section: 2. Electrical (Equipment, Devices, CCTV, UPS, Lighting & Fire Safety)
questions.questionText: Are the medicines & medical equipment available in good condition?
questions.description: Check stock condition, diagnostic equipment integrity, and storage environment.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: State which medicine category or equipment has failed condition check.
Has the damaged equipment been isolated from the active treatment bay?

questions.section: 2. Electrical (Equipment, Devices, CCTV, UPS, Lighting & Fire Safety)
questions.questionText: Are all the Fire extinguishers have a valid expiry date?
questions.description: Inspect hydro-test date and inspection tag on all CO2 / ABC fire extinguishers.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which extinguisher location has an expired inspection tag?

questions.section: 2. Electrical (Equipment, Devices, CCTV, UPS, Lighting & Fire Safety)
questions.questionText: Are all fire safety equipment working in good condition?
questions.description: Test smoke detectors, fire alarm pull stations, and hose reels.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which fire safety device failed functional testing?

questions.section: 2. Electrical (Equipment, Devices, CCTV, UPS, Lighting & Fire Safety)
questions.questionText: Are all the cameras functioning properly?
questions.description: Check CCTV camera live feed on security monitor and camera lens clarity.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which specific CCTV camera channel has lost video signal?

questions.section: 2. Electrical (Equipment, Devices, CCTV, UPS, Lighting & Fire Safety)
questions.questionText: Did you check the medical equipment (Monitor, BP equipment, etc.)?
questions.description: Test Patient Monitor, Sphygmomanometer, Stethoscope, Pulse Oximeter, and ECG Machine.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which electronic medical monitor or BP cuff failed calibration?

questions.section: 2. Electrical (Equipment, Devices, CCTV, UPS, Lighting & Fire Safety)
questions.questionText: Did you check the A/C working in all the floors?
questions.description: Test air conditioning cooling performance and compressor sound in all rooms.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which room or floor has a non-functional split AC unit?

questions.section: 2. Electrical (Equipment, Devices, CCTV, UPS, Lighting & Fire Safety)
questions.questionText: Did you check all the electrical items functioning properly? (Bulbs / Fans Switchboards)
questions.description: Inspect lighting bulbs, ceiling fans, switchboards, and electrical sockets.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Specify broken switchboards or fused light fixtures identified.

questions.questionText: Did you check the water supply?
questions.description: Test tap water pressure, continuous supply, overhead tank level, and RO purifier.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Is there a interruption in continuous potable water supply?

questions.questionText: Whether the essential registers maintained properly?
questions.description: Verify Out-Patient Log, Emergency Register, Pharmacy Stock Register, and Ambulance Log.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which specific official register is missing or un-updated?

questions.questionText: Are all the medicines have a valid expiry date?
questions.description: Audit pharmacy shelf stock and emergency crash cart for zero expired medications.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: List expired drug names and batch numbers identified.

questions.questionText: Are the emergency medicines available?
questions.description: Verify 100% availability of Adrenaline, Atropine, Antihistamines, and IV Fluids.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which critical emergency drug is out of stock?

questions.questionText: Are the dressing & injection items (Cotton, Gauze, Plaster, disposable syringe, etc.) available?
questions.description: Inspect sterile cotton rolls, gauze, adhesive plasters, and disposable needle syringes.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Which dressing or injection item is depleted below minimum threshold?

questions.questionText: Did you check the availability of Oxygen gas in the Cylinder?
questions.description: Inspect pressure gauge on main Oxygen cylinder (Must read >120 Bar).
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: What exact pressure reading (bar / psi) is shown on the Oxygen cylinder gauge?

questions.questionText: Did you check the Inventory and Ambulance Medicine?
questions.description: Audit campus emergency ambulance vehicle, portable suction, stretcher, and medicine box.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: Is the campus emergency ambulance operational and ready for deployment?

questions.questionText: Did you check the readiness of the Emergency Room?
questions.description: Verify emergency room readiness, staff responsiveness, and overall service satisfaction.
sampleFollowUpQuestionsIfNo: What critical item is missing from Emergency Room standby?
